questions.question: Whose downfall is taunted in Isaiah 14?
What proud boast is quoted and condemned in Isaiah 14?
options: 'I will rule over the raging sea and command all of the howling winds'
'I will live on forever and ever and shall never once taste of death'
'I will gather to myself the riches of all the kingdoms of the earth'
'I will ascend to heaven; I will make myself like the Most High'
questions.answer: 'I will ascend to heaven; I will make myself like the Most High'
